note: Small Superior National Forest campground on the Temperance River off the Sawbill Trail (Cook County 2), about 12 miles north of Tofte; not the state park of the same name on Lake Superior. Pine-shaded sites in a bend of the river; trout fishing and a large network of Forest Service roads for mountain biking. Run by a concessionaire. Sites were not designed for RVs: some fit a 23-ft rig, larger rigs may not. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT riverview KEPT (checked hard): FS 'pine-shaded campsites nestled in a bend of the Temperance River'. Imagery (snow-season frame): the site clearings sit on the north side of the bend at about 47.7176-47.7185, -90.8800 to -90.8783, under continuous pine canopy; the nearest clearing (~47.71752,-90.87805) is ~10-20 m from the bank behind a band of trees, the others 30-60 m back in forest. No site is on open ground at the water, so no riverfront; the river (~20-25 m wide here) is behind a thin tree line from the closest sites, which supports a view value. No official site photos exist to confirm a sightline.
